_doc: Single source of truth for the BlissOS x86_64 install-to-folder on p5 (Shared-Lib). The NVMe is fully partitioned (no free space for a native BlissOS partition), so BlissOS is laid into a folder on the existing ext4 p5 partition (android-x86 'install without formatting' style) and booted DIRECTLY by rEFInd: a native linux_partition stanza (volume=p5, loader=install.src_dir/kernel) — rEFInd's ext4 driver reads the real kernel file (no GRUB chainload; that's only needed for Debian/Kali whose /vmlinuz is a symlink). The BOOT ENTRY itself is owned by aa_bootloader/src/boot.json (grub.menu.blissos + grub.linux_order + the rEFInd manual_stanzas entry `from:blissos`); THIS file owns only the INSTALL (which release, which files, where, data.img size). Reproducible: release.sha256 is pinned by `install/build.sh lock`; `install` verifies it before extracting.

release._doc: Pick a BlissOS x86_64 release (GApps or Vanilla). Vanilla by default (no Google). Fill url from the chosen BlissRoms/x86 release asset (.iso), then run `./install/build.sh lock` to prefetch + record sha256 (nix SRI). version is descriptive only.

install._doc: src_dir is the folder on p5 that GRUB boots from (must match boot.json grub.menu.blissos.kernel/initrd path prefix = /blissos → mounted p5 root + /blissos). files[] are copied verbatim out of the ISO's live payload. data_img_size_mb is the persistent /data image created inside src_dir (DATA= empty in the cmdline → Android uses data.img here).

boot_entry_owner: aa_bootloader/src/boot.json (grub.menu.blissos + grub.linux_order[] + refind.manual_stanzas.order[] from:blissos). After install, render+deploy with: (cd ../aa_bootloader && ./build.sh deploy).
